entries.title: Numbers 17:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 17:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of [their] fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

words.text: of every one of them a rod

entries.title: Numbers 17:3
segments: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod [shall be] for the head of the house of their fathers.

entries.title: Numbers 17:4
segments: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

words.text: And thou shalt lay them up

entries.title: Numbers 17:5
segments: And it shall come to pass, [that] the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

: and I will make to cease

entries.title: Numbers 17:6
segments: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, [even] twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron [was] among their rods. {a rod...: Heb. a rod for one prince, a rod for one prince}

words.text: , and every one of their princes
. {a rod...: Heb. a rod for one prince, a rod for one prince}

entries.title: Numbers 17:7
segments: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

entries.title: Numbers 17:8
segments: ¶And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

words.text: ¶And it came to pass, that on the morrow

entries.title: Numbers 17:9
segments: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

entries.title: Numbers 17:10
segments: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not. {rebels: Heb. children of rebellion}

words.text: ; and thou shalt quite take away

entries.title: Numbers 17:11
segments: And Moses did [so]: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

entries.title: Numbers 17:12
segments: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

entries.title: Numbers 17:13
segments: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
